Every element goes through\n_element, which refuses any element or attribute outside the spec's fixed\nvocabulary, and any attribute value that isn't one of:\n  - a number this module formatted (and checked with math.isfinite),\n  - a palette constant (fill, stroke), a fixed class name, or a fixed token,\n  - the title's id, `chart-<key>-<n>-title`.\nWriter strings (title, labels, units, source, category and series names,\ncell text) are only ever text content, escaped by _text.\n\nLayout is in the SVG's own units: the stylesheet (app.public_site.CSS) sets\nits text to FONT units and scales the SVG to the column. Both drawings share\nthe scale, so the phone one starts its axis where the wide one does.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport math\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom html import escape\n\nfrom app.charts import Chart, Unit\n\n# The palette (dataviz reference palette, slots 1 to 4, light steps). The\n# stylesheet swaps in the dark steps by class in dark mode.\nSERIES = (\"#2a78d6\", \"#eb6834\", \"#1baf7a\", \"#eda100\")\nINK = \"#52514e\"       # labels, values, legend, axis titles\nMUTED = \"#898781\"     # tick labels\nGRID = \"#e1e0d9\"\nBASELINE = \"#a3a29b\"\nSURFACE = \"#ffffff\"   # the ring around a marker\nNONE = \"none\"         # a line's fill\nPALETTE = frozenset({*SERIES, INK, MUTED, GRID, BASELINE, SURFACE, NONE})\n\nELEMENTS = frozenset({\"figure\", \"figcaption\", \"svg\", \"g\", \"title\", \"rect\", \"line\", \"polyline\",\n                      \"circle\", \"text\", \"p\", \"small\", \"details\", \"summary\", \"table\", \"thead\",\n                      \"tbody\", \"tr\", \"th\", \"td\"})\nATTRIBUTES = frozenset({\"class\", \"viewBox\", \"role\", \"aria-labelledby\", \"aria-hidden\", \"id\", \"x\",\n                        \"y\", \"x1\", \"y1\", \"x2\", \"y2\", \"width\", \"height\", \"cx\", \"cy\", \"r\",\n                        \"points\", \"fill\", \"stroke\", \"stroke-width\", \"text-anchor\", \"scope\"})\n_SERIES_CLASSES = tuple(f\"chart-series-{i}\" for i in range(1, len(SERIES) + 1))\n_LINE_CLASSES = tuple(f\"chart-line-{i}\" for i in range(1, len(SERIES) + 1))\n_MARKER_CLASSES = tuple(f\"chart-marker-{i}\" for i in range(1, len(SERIES) + 1))\nCLASSES = frozenset({\"chart-figure\", \"chart-title\", \"chart-svg\", \"chart-svg-phone\", \"chart-grid\", \"chart-baseline\",\n                     \"chart-tick\", \"chart-category\", \"chart-value\", \"chart-axis-title\",\n                     \"chart-legend\", \"chart-note\", \"chart-source\", \"chart-data\",\n                     *_SERIES_CLASSES, *_LINE_CLASSES, *_MARKER_CLASSES})\n_NUMERIC = frozenset({\"x\", \"y\", \"x1\", \"y1\", \"x2\", \"y2\", \"width\", \"height\", \"cx\", \"cy\", \"r\",\n                      \"stroke-width\"})\n_TOKENS = {\"role\": {\"img\"}, \"text-anchor\": {\"start\", \"middle\", \"end\"}, \"scope\": {\"row\", \"col\"},\n           \"aria-hidden\": {\"true\"}}\nTITLE_ID = re.compile(r\"chart-[0-9a-f]{32}-[0-9]+-title\")\n\nPRIVACY_NOTE = \"Some values are suppressed for privacy.\"\nDATA_SUMMARY = \"Show the data\"\n\n# Each Chart is drawn twice: WIDTH units wide, and PHONE_WIDTH for a narrow\n# screen, which the stylesheet shows in its place, so its text stays near\n# FONT pixels on a phone rather than shrinking with a wide drawing.\nWIDTH = 520\nPHONE_WIDTH = 360\nFONT = 13            # the stylesheet's size for the SVG's text\n_CHAR = FONT * 0.6   # an estimate of one character's width\n_LINE = 18           # a line of text\n_PLOT_HEIGHT = 220\n_BAR = 24            # the thickest a bar is\n_GAP = 2             # between touching bars\n\n\nclass ChartDrawError(RuntimeError):\n    \"\"\"The drawing broke its own rules: a bug, never a writer's mistake.\"\"\"\n\n\n# Building elements.\n\ndef _number(value: float) -> str:\n    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or not math.isfinite(value):\n        raise ChartDrawError(f\"not a finite number: {value!r}\")\n    text = f\"{value:.2f}\".rstrip(\"0\").rstrip(\".\")\n    return \"0\" if text == \"-0\" else text\n\n\ndef _value(name: str, value: object) -> str:\n    \"\"\"An attribute's value, if the vocabulary allows it.\"\"\"\n    if name == \"viewBox\":\n        return \" \".join(map(_number, value))\n    if name == \"points\":\n        return \" \".join(f\"{_number(x)},{_number(y)}\" for x, y in value)\n    if name in _NUMERIC:\n        return _number(value)\n    allowed = (name == \"class\" and value in CLASSES\n               or name in (\"fill\", \"stroke\") and value in PALETTE\n               or name in (\"id\", \"aria-labelledby\") and TITLE_ID.fullmatch(str(value))\n               or value in _TOKENS.get(name, ()))\n    if not allowed:\n        raise ChartDrawError(f\"{name}={value!r} is not in the vocabulary\")\n    return str(value)\n\n\ndef _element(name: str, attributes: dict | None = None, *content: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"An element of the vocabulary. `content` is elements from here, or\n    _text: never a writer's string as it is.\"\"\"\n    if name not in ELEMENTS:\n        raise ChartDrawError(f\"<{name}> is not in the vocabulary\")\n    parts = []\n    for key, value in (attributes or {}).items():\n        if key not in ATTRIBUTES:\n            raise ChartDrawError(f\"{key} is not in the vocabulary\")\n        parts.append(f' {key}=\"{_value(key, value)}\"')\n    return f\"<{name}{''.join(parts)}>{''.join(content)}</{name}>\"\n\n\ndef _text(text: str) -> str:\n    return escape(text, quote=True)\n\n\n30:SERIES = (\"#2a78d6\", \"#eb6834\", \"#1baf7a\", \"#eda100\")\n31:INK = \"#52514e\"       # labels, values, legend, axis {"parentUuid":"d2fcb9f8-280f-41cf-bc47-30e298d41c28","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"3fed6bb3-3edb-447d-888d-7ec4eb8a7614","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01NSd5kveKARCgVSwCBMhoiL","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The Editor's server side (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe body is stored as Markdown. The Editor shows it as HTML and posts HTML\nback, which app.markdown_form turns into Markdown again. This module decides\nwhat the Editor is shown, and what a posted body saves.\n\n**Locked blocks.** A top-level block of the stored body that the Editor can't\nrepresent (a code block, raw HTML, an inline code span, ...) is *locked*: it\nis cut out and replaced by the token `locked-<n>` (n: its place among the\nbody's locked blocks), and the Editor shows its rendered, sanitized HTML,\nread-only. Its Markdown source never reaches the browser. On save, each token\nis replaced by that block's source from the *stored* body, never from\nanything posted.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markupsafe import Markup, escape\n\nfrom app import charts\nfrom app.content import STALE, ContentError, StaleItem, item_base\nfrom app.markdown_form import LOCKED_TOKEN, ImageName, is_link, to_markdown\nfrom app.rendering import (IMAGE_REFERENCE, ImageSrc, parse, render_markdown,\n                           table_cell_alignment)\nfrom app.site_links import REFERENCE, TABLES\n\n# Block tokens the Editor can represent, and the headings among them.\n_SUPPORTED_BLOCKS = {\n    \"paragraph_open\", \"paragraph_close\", \"heading_open\", \"heading_close\", \"inline\",\n    \"bullet_list_open\", \"bullet_list_close\", \"ordered_list_open\", \"ordered_list_close\",\n    \"list_item_open\", \"list_item_close\", \"blockquote_open\", \"blockquote_close\",\n    \"table_open\", \"table_close\", \"thead_open\", \"thead_close\", \"tbody_open\", \"tbody_close\",\n    \"tr_open\", \"tr_close\", \"th_open\", \"th_close\", \"td_open\", \"td_close\",\n}\n_SUPPORTED_HEADINGS = {\"h2\", \"h3\"}\n_SUPPORTED_INLINE = {\"text\", \"softbreak\", \"hardbreak\", \"strong_open\", \"strong_close\",\n                     \"em_open\", \"em_close\", \"link_open\", \"link_close\", \"image\"}\n_NEWLINE = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n?|\\n\")\n_LAST_ENDING = re.compile(r\"(?:\\r\\n?|\\n)\\Z\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"A body with each locked block replaced by its token.\"\"\"\n    markdown: str\n    # The locked blocks' Markdown source, by token number.\n    locked: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\ndef _supported_inline(token: Token) -> bool:\n    if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_INLINE:\n        return False\n    if token.type == \"link_open\":\n        return is_link(str(token.attrGet(\"href\"))) and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n    if token.type == \"image\":\n        return (str(token.attrGet(\"src\")).startswith(IMAGE_REFERENCE)\n                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n                and all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])))\n    return True\n\n\ndef _token_number(block: list[Token]) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"The number of the token a top-level block is, if it is a paragraph\n    holding nothing but one.\"\"\"\n    if [token.type for token in block] != [\"paragraph_open\", \"inline\", \"paragraph_close\"]:\n        return None\n    match = LOCKED_TOKEN.fullmatch(block[1].content)\n    return int(match[1]) if match else None\n\n\ndef _supported(block: list[Token]) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether the Editor can represent a top-level block, given as its\n    tokens: it and everything in it.\"\"\"\n    if _token_number(block) is not None:\n        # Text that reads as a token; locked, so it is never taken for one.\n        return False\n    for token in block:\n        if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_BLOCKS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"heading_open\" and token.tag not in _SUPPORTED_HEADINGS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"inline\" and not all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])):\n            return False\n    return True\n\n\ndef _top_level_blocks(tokens: list[Token]) -> list[list[Token]]:\n    \"\"\"The tokens of each top-level block, in order.\"\"\"\n    blocks: list[list[Token]] = []\n    depth = 0\n    for token in tokens:\n        if depth == 0:\n            blocks.append([])\n        blocks[-1].append(token)\n        depth += token.nesting\n    return blocks\n\n\ndef _lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"`text`'s lines, each with its line ending, numbered as markdown-it\n    numbers them (it reads \\\\r\\\\n and \\\\r as \\\\n).\"\"\"\n    parts = _NEWLINE.split(text)\n    endings = _NEWLINE.findall(text)\n    lines = [part + ending for part, ending in zip(parts, endings)]\n    return lines + [parts[-1]] if parts[-1] else lines\n\n\ndef _ending(line: str) -> str:\n    return line[len(line.rstrip(\"\\r\\n\")):] or \"\\n\"\n\n\ndef _is_blank(line: str) -> bool:\n    return not line.strip()\n\n\ndef tokenize(body: str) -> Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"`body` with each locked block replaced by its token, on a line of its\n    own with a blank line either side.\"\"\"\n    lines = _lines(body)\n    locked: list[str] = []\n    # (first line, line after the last) of each locked block.\n    spans = []\n    for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(body)):\n        if block[0].map and not _supported(block):\n            start, end = block[0].map\n            while end > start and _is_blank(lines[end - 1]):\n                end -= 1\n            spans.append((start, end))\n    written: list[str] = []\n    at = 0\n    for start, end in spans:\n        written.extend(lines[at:start])\n        if written and not _is_blank(written[-1]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        # The token keeps the line ending of the block's last line, so that\n        # putting the block back gives its bytes exactly.\n        written.append(f\"locked-{len(locked)}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\")\n        # Its bytes exactly, less the ending of its last line.\n        locked.append(_LAST_ENDING.sub(\"\", \"\".join(lines[start:end])))\n        if end < len(lines) and not _is_blank(lines[end]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        at = end\n    written.extend(lines[at:])\n    markdown = \"\".join(written)\n    if spans and spans[-1][1] == len(lines) and not body.endswith((\"\\n\", \"\\r\")):\n        markdown = markdown.removesuffix(\"\\n\")\n    return Tokenized(markdown, tuple(locked))\n\n\ndef _token_paragraphs(markdown: str) -> list[tuple[int, int, int]]:\n    \"\"\"Where `markdown` holds a locked block's token: (first line, line after\n    the last, token number) of each top-level paragraph that is one.\"\"\"\n    return [(block[0].map[0], block[0].map[1], number)\n            for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(markdown))\n            if (number := _token_number(block)) is not None]\n\n\nUNKNOWN_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here is not in the saved \"\n                 \"version. Reload the page to get the saved version back.\")\nDUPLICATE_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here appears twice. \"\n                   \"Remove one of them.\")\n\n\ndef restore(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`markdown` with each token replaced by its locked block from `stored`,\n    byte for byte. A token that is missing was removed, with its block.\n    ContentError for a token `stored` has no block for, or one used twice.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    found = _token_paragraphs(markdown)\n    numbers = [number for _, _, number in found]\n    if any(number >= len(locked) for number in numbers):\n        raise ContentError(UNKNOWN_TOKEN)\n    if len(set(numbers)) != len(numbers):\n        raise ContentError(DUPLICATE_TOKEN)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for start, end, number in reversed(found):\n        lines[start:end] = [locked[number] + _ending(lines[end - 1])]\n    return \"\".join(lines)\n\n\n# The Editor's HTML.\n\nLOCKED_NOTE = \"This part can't be edited here.\"\n\n\ndef _site_link(href: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The Editor shows a site link as the site reference it is, resolved or\n    not, so that it posts it back as it is and marks one that won't resolve.\"\"\"\n    return href if REFERENCE.fullmatch(href) else None\n\n\ndef _locked_html(number: int, locked: tuple[str, ...], image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A locked block as the Editor shows it: its rendered, sanitized HTML,\n    never its source. Its token is the only thing the Editor posts back.\"\"\"\n    shown = (render_markdown(locked[number], image_src, _site_link)\n             if number < len(locked) else \"\")\n    return (f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked\" data-locked=\"locked-{number}\">'\n            f'<p class=\"admin-editor-locked-note\">{escape(LOCKED_NOTE)}</p>'\n            f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked-shown\">{shown}</div></div>')\n\n\ndef editor_html(markdown: str, stored: str, image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> Markup:\n    \"\"\"What the Editor shows for `markdown`, a tokenized body (usually\n    tokenize(stored).markdown), whose tokens are `stored`'s locked blocks.\n    Rendered and sanitized as the site renders it, with each chart image's\n    src from `image_src`.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    # Each token is swapped for a placeholder only this call knows, so that\n    # nothing the writer typed can render as one.\n    nonce = secrets.token_hex(16)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for start, end, number in _token_paragraphs(markdown):\n        lines[start:end] = [f\"locked-{nonce}-{number}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\"]\n    html = str(render_markdown(\"\".join(lines), image_src, _site_link))\n    return Markup(re.sub(rf\"<p>locked-{nonce}-(\\d+)</p>\",\n                         lambda m: _locked_html(int(m[1]), locked, image_src), html))\n\n\n# What a post saves.\n\n# The Editor's HTML as nh3 lets it through, before app.markdown_form reads it:\n# only what the Editor can represent, and each locked block's token.\n_POSTED_TAGS = {\"p\", \"br\", \"strong\", \"b\", \"em\", \"i\", \"a\", \"img\", \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\",\n                \"blockquote\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\", \"table\", \"thead\",\n                \"tbody\", \"tfoot\", \"tr\", \"th\", \"td\", \"div\", \"span\"}\n_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\"}, \"ol\": {\"start\"},\n                      \"th\": {\"style\", \"colspan\", \"rowspan\"},\n                      \"td\": {\"style\", \"colspan\", \"rowspan\"}, \"div\": {\"data-locked\"}}\n\n\n# A posted link's schemes, site links' included; app.markdown_form keeps\n# only the links the Editor may have (is_link).\n_POSTED_SCHEMES = {\"https\", \"mailto\", *TABLES}\n\n\ndef _sanitized(html: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(html, tags=_POSTED_TAGS, attributes=_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                     attribute_filter=table_cell_alignment, link_rel=None,\n                     url_schemes=_POSTED_SCHEMES)\n\n\ndef _with_lf(text: str) -> str:\n    return _NEWLINE.sub(\"\\n\", text)\n\n\ndef canonical_charts(markdown: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`markdown` with each top-level Chart in it in canonical form (spec\n    #14), with the line endings of the line that closes it. A Chart that\n    breaks a rule is left as it is, for app.content.validate to name.\"\"\"\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for token in reversed(parse(markdown)):\n        if not (charts.is_chart(token) and token.level == 0 and token.map):\n            continue\n        try:\n            chart = charts.parse(token.content)\n        except charts.ChartError:\n            continue\n        start, end = token.map\n        ending = _ending(lines[end - 1])\n        fence = f\"```{charts.INFO}\\n{chart.canonical()}```\\n\"\n        lines[start:end] = [fence.replace(\"\\n\", ending)]\n    return \"\".join(lines)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Posted:\n    \"\"\"A body as an edit form posts it. With the Editor, `body_html` is its\n    HTML and `body_dirty` whether the writer changed it. Without (the\n    script didn't load), `body_html` is None and `body` is the textarea's\n    Markdown: the tokenized body, as the page gave it, perhaps edited.\"\"\"\n    body: str\n    body_html: str | None\n    body_dirty: bool\n\n    def untouched(self, stored: str) -> bool:\n        if self.body_html is not None:\n            return not self.body_dirty\n        return _with_lf(self.body) == _with_lf(tokenize(stored).markdown)\n\n    def markdown(self, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The body the writer wants, tokenized. ContentError if the Editor's\n        HTML has a locked block it didn't make.\"\"\"\n        if self.body_html is None:\n            return canonical_charts(self.body)\n        return to_markdown(_sanitized(self.body_html), image_name)\n\n\ndef saved_body(posted: Posted, stored: str | None, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for `posted`, over `stored` (None for a new item). An\n    untouched body is `stored` exactly, whatever was posted; any other is the\n    posted body, in standard form if from the Editor, with its locked blocks\n    put back from `stored`. ContentError if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return stored\n    return restore(posted.markdown(image_name), stored or \"\")\n\n\n# The edit and create forms.\n\nNEEDS_BASE = \"This page is out of date. Reload it to see the latest version.\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"How the Editor shows an item's chart images, and reads them back.\"\"\"\n    src: ImageSrc\n    name: ImageName\n\n\ndef image_links(prefix: str) -> ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"For an item whose chart images the admin console serves at\n    `prefix`<name> (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/images/).\"\"\"\n    def name(src: str) -> str | None:\n        rest = src.removeprefix(prefix)\n        return unquote(rest) if src.startswith(prefix) and rest and \"/\" not in rest else None\n\n    return ImageLinks(src=lambda image: prefix + quote(image, safe=\"\"), name=name)\n\n\ndef form_for(item: Mapping) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The edit form for a stored item, as the page opens: its body\n    tokenized, and its base version.\"\"\"\n    return {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"slug\": item[\"slug\"],\n            \"body\": tokenize(item[\"body\"]).markdown,\n            \"item_base\": item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]),\n            \"body_dirty\": False}\n\n\ndef form_after(posted: Posted, title: str, slug: str, base: str, stored: str | None,\n               image_name: ImageName | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The form again after a refused save of `posted`, with what the writer\n    had, and the same base version, so a stale form stays refused.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return {**form_for({\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": stored}),\n                \"item_base\": base}\n    try:\n        body = posted.markdown(image_name)\n    except ContentError:\n        # Editor HTML it didn't make: the Editor opens on the stored body again.\n        body = tokenize(stored or \"\").markdown\n    return {\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body, \"item_base\": base, \"body_dirty\": True}\n\n\ndef full_body(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form's tokenized body with its locked blocks back, for the Site\n    preview; as it is if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return restore(markdown, stored)\n    except ContentError:\n        return markdown\n\n\ndef saved_edit(posted: Posted, item: Mapping, base: str, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for an edit of the stored `item` from a form opened\n    on `base`. StaleItem if the item has changed since; ContentError if the\n    Editor posted without a base version, or as saved_body. Old forms and\n    scripts that post no base, and no Editor HTML, are not checked.\"\"\"\n    if base and base != item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]):\n        raise StaleItem(STALE)\n    if posted.body_html is not None and not base:\n        raise ContentError(NEEDS_BASE)\n    return saved_body(posted, item[\"body\"], image_name)","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"01543589-e3d3-44c4-9b45-a629090e0107","timestamp":"2026-10-01T14:48:50.959Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"The Editor's server side (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe body is stored as Markdown. On save, each token\nis replaced by that block's source from the *stored* body, never from\nanything posted.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markupsafe import Markup, escape\n\nfrom app import charts\nfrom app.content import STALE, ContentError, StaleItem, item_base\nfrom app.markdown_form import LOCKED_TOKEN, ImageName, is_link, to_markdown\nfrom app.rendering import (IMAGE_REFERENCE, ImageSrc, parse, render_markdown,\n                           table_cell_alignment)\nfrom app.site_links import REFERENCE, TABLES\n\n# Block tokens the Editor can represent, and the headings among them.\n_SUPPORTED_BLOCKS = {\n    \"paragraph_open\", \"paragraph_close\", \"heading_open\", \"heading_close\", \"inline\",\n    \"bullet_list_open\", \"bullet_list_close\", \"ordered_list_open\", \"ordered_list_close\",\n    \"list_item_open\", \"list_item_close\", \"blockquote_open\", \"blockquote_close\",\n    \"table_open\", \"table_close\", \"thead_open\", \"thead_close\", \"tbody_open\", \"tbody_close\",\n    \"tr_open\", \"tr_close\", \"th_open\", \"th_close\", \"td_open\", \"td_close\",\n}\n_SUPPORTED_HEADINGS = {\"h2\", \"h3\"}\n_SUPPORTED_INLINE = {\"text\", \"softbreak\", \"hardbreak\", \"strong_open\", \"strong_close\",\n                     \"em_open\", \"em_close\", \"link_open\", \"link_close\", \"image\"}\n_NEWLINE = re.compile(r\"\\r\\n?|\\n\")\n_LAST_ENDING = re.compile(r\"(?:\\r\\n?|\\n)\\Z\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"A body with each locked block replaced by its token.\"\"\"\n    markdown: str\n    # The locked blocks' Markdown source, by token number.\n    locked: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\ndef _supported_inline(token: Token) -> bool:\n    if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_INLINE:\n        return False\n    if token.type == \"link_open\":\n        return is_link(str(token.attrGet(\"href\"))) and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n    if token.type == \"image\":\n        return (str(token.attrGet(\"src\")).startswith(IMAGE_REFERENCE)\n                and token.attrGet(\"title\") is None\n                and all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])))\n    return True\n\n\ndef _token_number(block: list[Token]) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"The number of the token a top-level block is, if it is a paragraph\n    holding nothing but one.\"\"\"\n    if [token.type for token in block] != [\"paragraph_open\", \"inline\", \"paragraph_close\"]:\n        return None\n    match = LOCKED_TOKEN.fullmatch(block[1].content)\n    return int(match[1]) if match else None\n\n\ndef _supported(block: list[Token]) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether the Editor can represent a top-level block, given as its\n    tokens: it and everything in it.\"\"\"\n    if _token_number(block) is not None:\n        # Text that reads as a token; locked, so it is never taken for one.\n        return False\n    for token in block:\n        if token.type not in _SUPPORTED_BLOCKS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"heading_open\" and token.tag not in _SUPPORTED_HEADINGS:\n            return False\n        if token.type == \"inline\" and not all(map(_supported_inline, token.children or [])):\n            return False\n    return True\n\n\ndef _top_level_blocks(tokens: list[Token]) -> list[list[Token]]:\n    \"\"\"The tokens of each top-level block, in order.\"\"\"\n    blocks: list[list[Token]] = []\n    depth = 0\n    for token in tokens:\n        if depth == 0:\n            blocks.append([])\n        blocks[-1].append(token)\n        depth += token.nesting\n    return blocks\n\n\ndef _lines(text: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"`text`'s lines, each with its line ending, numbered as markdown-it\n    numbers them (it reads \\\\r\\\\n and \\\\r as \\\\n).\"\"\"\n    parts = _NEWLINE.split(text)\n    endings = _NEWLINE.findall(text)\n    lines = [part + ending for part, ending in zip(parts, endings)]\n    return lines + [parts[-1]] if parts[-1] else lines\n\n\ndef _ending(line: str) -> str:\n    return line[len(line.rstrip(\"\\r\\n\")):] or \"\\n\"\n\n\ndef _is_blank(line: str) -> bool:\n    return not line.strip()\n\n\ndef tokenize(body: str) -> Tokenized:\n    \"\"\"`body` with each locked block replaced by its token, on a line of its\n    own with a blank line either side.\"\"\"\n    lines = _lines(body)\n    locked: list[str] = []\n    # (first line, line after the last) of each locked block.\n    spans = []\n    for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(body)):\n        if block[0].map and not _supported(block):\n            start, end = block[0].map\n            while end > start and _is_blank(lines[end - 1]):\n                end -= 1\n            spans.append((start, end))\n    written: list[str] = []\n    at = 0\n    for start, end in spans:\n        written.extend(lines[at:start])\n        if written and not _is_blank(written[-1]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        # The token keeps the line ending of the block's last line, so that\n        # putting the block back gives its bytes exactly.\n        written.append(f\"locked-{len(locked)}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\")\n        # Its bytes exactly, less the ending of its last line.\n        locked.append(_LAST_ENDING.sub(\"\", \"\".join(lines[start:end])))\n        if end < len(lines) and not _is_blank(lines[end]):\n            written.append(\"\\n\")\n        at = end\n    written.extend(lines[at:])\n    markdown = \"\".join(written)\n    if spans and spans[-1][1] == len(lines) and not body.endswith((\"\\n\", \"\\r\")):\n        markdown = markdown.removesuffix(\"\\n\")\n    return Tokenized(markdown, tuple(locked))\n\n\ndef _token_paragraphs(markdown: str) -> list[tuple[int, int, int]]:\n    \"\"\"Where `markdown` holds a locked block's token: (first line, line after\n    the last, token number) of each top-level paragraph that is one.\"\"\"\n    return [(block[0].map[0], block[0].map[1], number)\n            for block in _top_level_blocks(parse(markdown))\n            if (number := _token_number(block)) is not None]\n\n\nUNKNOWN_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here is not in the saved \"\n                 \"version. Reload the page to get the saved version back.\")\nDUPLICATE_TOKEN = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here appears twice. \"\n                   \"Remove one of them.\")\n\n\ndef restore(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`markdown` with each token replaced by its locked block from `stored`,\n    byte for byte. A token that is missing was removed, with its block.\n    ContentError for a token `stored` has no block for, or one used twice.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    found = _token_paragraphs(markdown)\n    numbers = [number for _, _, number in found]\n    if any(number >= len(locked) for number in numbers):\n        raise ContentError(UNKNOWN_TOKEN)\n    if len(set(numbers)) != len(numbers):\n        raise ContentError(DUPLICATE_TOKEN)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for start, end, number in reversed(found):\n        lines[start:end] = [locked[number] + _ending(lines[end - 1])]\n    return \"\".join(lines)\n\n\n# The Editor's HTML.\n\nLOCKED_NOTE = \"This part can't be edited here.\"\n\n\ndef _site_link(href: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The Editor shows a site link as the site reference it is, resolved or\n    not, so that it posts it back as it is and marks one that won't resolve.\"\"\"\n    return href if REFERENCE.fullmatch(href) else None\n\n\ndef _locked_html(number: int, locked: tuple[str, ...], image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A locked block as the Editor shows it: its rendered, sanitized HTML,\n    never its source. Its token is the only thing the Editor posts back.\"\"\"\n    shown = (render_markdown(locked[number], image_src, _site_link)\n             if number < len(locked) else \"\")\n    return (f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked\" data-locked=\"locked-{number}\">'\n            f'<p class=\"admin-editor-locked-note\">{escape(LOCKED_NOTE)}</p>'\n            f'<div class=\"admin-editor-locked-shown\">{shown}</div></div>')\n\n\ndef editor_html(markdown: str, stored: str, image_src: ImageSrc | None) -> Markup:\n    \"\"\"What the Editor shows for `markdown`, a tokenized body (usually\n    tokenize(stored).markdown), whose tokens are `stored`'s locked blocks.\n    Rendered and sanitized as the site renders it, with each chart image's\n    src from `image_src`.\"\"\"\n    locked = tokenize(stored).locked\n    # Each token is swapped for a placeholder only this call knows, so that\n    # nothing the writer typed can render as one.\n    nonce = secrets.token_hex(16)\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for start, end, number in _token_paragraphs(markdown):\n        lines[start:end] = [f\"locked-{nonce}-{number}{_ending(lines[end - 1])}\"]\n    html = str(render_markdown(\"\".join(lines), image_src, _site_link))\n    return Markup(re.sub(rf\"<p>locked-{nonce}-(\\d+)</p>\",\n                         lambda m: _locked_html(int(m[1]), locked, image_src), html))\n\n\n# What a post saves.\n\n# The Editor's HTML as nh3 lets it through, before app.markdown_form reads it:\n# only what the Editor can represent, and each locked block's token.\n_POSTED_TAGS = {\"p\", \"br\", \"strong\", \"b\", \"em\", \"i\", \"a\", \"img\", \"ul\", \"ol\", \"li\",\n                \"blockquote\", \"h1\", \"h2\", \"h3\", \"h4\", \"h5\", \"h6\", \"table\", \"thead\",\n                \"tbody\", \"tfoot\", \"tr\", \"th\", \"td\", \"div\", \"span\"}\n_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES = {\"a\": {\"href\"}, \"img\": {\"src\", \"alt\"}, \"ol\": {\"start\"},\n                      \"th\": {\"style\", \"colspan\", \"rowspan\"},\n                      \"td\": {\"style\", \"colspan\", \"rowspan\"}, \"div\": {\"data-locked\"}}\n\n\n# A posted link's schemes, site links' included; app.markdown_form keeps\n# only the links the Editor may have (is_link).\n_POSTED_SCHEMES = {\"https\", \"mailto\", *TABLES}\n\n\ndef _sanitized(html: str) -> str:\n    return nh3.clean(html, tags=_POSTED_TAGS, attributes=_POSTED_ATTRIBUTES,\n                     attribute_filter=table_cell_alignment, link_rel=None,\n                     url_schemes=_POSTED_SCHEMES)\n\n\ndef _with_lf(text: str) -> str:\n    return _NEWLINE.sub(\"\\n\", text)\n\n\ndef canonical_charts(markdown: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`markdown` with each top-level Chart in it in canonical form (spec\n    #14), with the line endings of the line that closes it. A Chart that\n    breaks a rule is left as it is, for app.content.validate to name.\"\"\"\n    lines = _lines(markdown)\n    for token in reversed(parse(markdown)):\n        if not (charts.is_chart(token) and token.level == 0 and token.map):\n            continue\n        try:\n            chart = charts.parse(token.content)\n        except charts.ChartError:\n            continue\n        start, end = token.map\n        ending = _ending(lines[end - 1])\n        fence = f\"```{charts.INFO}\\n{chart.canonical()}```\\n\"\n        lines[start:end] = [fence.replace(\"\\n\", ending)]\n    return \"\".join(lines)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Posted:\n    \"\"\"A body as an edit form posts it. With the Editor, `body_html` is its\n    HTML and `body_dirty` whether the writer changed it. Without (the\n    script didn't load), `body_html` is None and `body` is the textarea's\n    Markdown: the tokenized body, as the page gave it, perhaps edited.\"\"\"\n    body: str\n    body_html: str | None\n    body_dirty: bool\n\n    def untouched(self, stored: str) -> bool:\n        if self.body_html is not None:\n            return not self.body_dirty\n        return _with_lf(self.body) == _with_lf(tokenize(stored).markdown)\n\n    def markdown(self, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The body the writer wants, tokenized. ContentError if the Editor's\n        HTML has a locked block it didn't make.\"\"\"\n        if self.body_html is None:\n            return canonical_charts(self.body)\n        return to_markdown(_sanitized(self.body_html), image_name)\n\n\ndef saved_body(posted: Posted, stored: str | None, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for `posted`, over `stored` (None for a new item). An\n    untouched body is `stored` exactly, whatever was posted; any other is the\n    posted body, in standard form if from the Editor, with its locked blocks\n    put back from `stored`. ContentError if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return stored\n    return restore(posted.markdown(image_name), stored or \"\")\n\n\n# The edit and create forms.\n\nNEEDS_BASE = \"This page is out of date. Reload it to see the latest version.\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"How the Editor shows an item's chart images, and reads them back.\"\"\"\n    src: ImageSrc\n    name: ImageName\n\n\ndef image_links(prefix: str) -> ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"For an item whose chart images the admin console serves at\n    `prefix`<name> (e.g. /admin/data-bites/3/images/).\"\"\"\n    def name(src: str) -> str | None:\n        rest = src.removeprefix(prefix)\n        return unquote(rest) if src.startswith(prefix) and rest and \"/\" not in rest else None\n\n    return ImageLinks(src=lambda image: prefix + quote(image, safe=\"\"), name=name)\n\n\ndef form_for(item: Mapping) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The edit form for a stored item, as the page opens: its body\n    tokenized, and its base version.\"\"\"\n    return {\"title\": item[\"title\"], \"slug\": item[\"slug\"],\n            \"body\": tokenize(item[\"body\"]).markdown,\n            \"item_base\": item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]),\n            \"body_dirty\": False}\n\n\ndef form_after(posted: Posted, title: str, slug: str, base: str, stored: str | None,\n               image_name: ImageName | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The form again after a refused save of `posted`, with what the writer\n    had, and the same base version, so a stale form stays refused.\"\"\"\n    if stored is not None and posted.untouched(stored):\n        return {**form_for({\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": stored}),\n                \"item_base\": base}\n    try:\n        body = posted.markdown(image_name)\n    except ContentError:\n        # Editor HTML it didn't make: the Editor opens on the stored body again.\n        body = tokenize(stored or \"\").markdown\n    return {\"title\": title, \"slug\": slug, \"body\": body, \"item_base\": base, \"body_dirty\": True}\n\n\ndef full_body(markdown: str, stored: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form's tokenized body with its locked blocks back, for the Site\n    preview; as it is if it can't be.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return restore(markdown, stored)\n    except ContentError:\n        return markdown\n\n\ndef saved_edit(posted: Posted, item: Mapping, base: str, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body to save for an edit of the stored `item` from a form opened\n    on `base`. StaleItem if the item has changed since; ContentError if the\n    Editor posted without a base version, or as saved_body. Old forms and\n    scripts that post no base, and no Editor HTML, are not checked.\"\"\"\n    if base and base != item_base(item[\"title\"], item[\"slug\"], item[\"body\"]):\n        raise StaleItem(STALE)\n    if posted.body_html is not None and not base:\n        raise ContentError(NEEDS_BASE)\n    return saved_body(posted, item[\"body\"], image_name)","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"dab7b58f-eee1-41ed-be4f-67203929350d","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":7},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d2fcb9f8-280f-41cf-bc47-30e298d41c28","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"926c42f6-77b8-4443-a7eb-ec96fce93b5c","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"ac97b92a-a72e-419a-81a2-209a77b1ca22","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"3fed6bb3-3edb-447d-888d-7ec4eb8a7614","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01X5KeYNmK4ddwQMAGXeDUop","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Editor HTML to Markdown in its standard form (spec #14, ADR-005).\n\nThe Editor posts HTML; the body is stored as Markdown. app.editor sanitizes\nthe posted HTML with nh3 first, and this module turns what is left into\nMarkdown, written one standard way, with stdlib `html.parser`. It writes only\nwhat the Editor supports: paragraphs, Sections (H2) and Subsections (H3),\nbulleted and numbered lists, block quotes, tables, and bold, italic, line\nbreaks, `https:`/`mailto:` and site links (app.site_links), and chart images\ninline. Any other element is let through as its text. Everything the writer typed is escaped, so it\nrenders as the text it is and never as Markdown syntax.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\n\nfrom app.content import ContentError\nfrom app.rendering import LINK_SCHEMES\nfrom app.site_links import REFERENCE\n\n# A locked block's token (app.editor): on its own, a top-level paragraph that\n# the stored block is put back in place of. The Editor shows the block as an\n# empty <div data-locked=\"locked-<n>\">, and it is written as its token.\nLOCKED_TOKEN = re.compile(r\"locked-(\\d+)\")\n_LOCKED = \"data-locked\"\n_LOCKED_MOVED = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here was moved into a list, \"\n                 \"quote, table, or paragraph. Move it back, or remove it.\")\n_LOCKED_FORGED = (\"A part of the body that can't be edited here was changed. Reload the \"\n                  \"page to get it back.\")\n\n# An <img>'s src -> the name of the item's chart image it shows; None for\n# any other picture, which is dropped.\nImageName = Callable[[str], \"str | None\"]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass _Element:\n    tag: str\n    attrs: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    children: list[_Element | str] = field(default_factory=list)\n\n\n# Elements with no end tag, which never hold children.\n_VOID = {\"br\", \"img\", \"hr\", \"input\", \"meta\", \"link\", \"wbr\", \"col\", \"source\"}\n# Elements whose content is never text for the body (nh3 drops them too).\n_SKIPPED = {\"script\", \"style\", \"template\", \"head\", \"title\"}\n\n\nclass _TreeBuilder(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"The HTML as a tree of _Elements. Forgiving: an end tag closes the\n    nearest open element of its name, and one with none open is ignored.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.root = _Element(\"root\")\n        self._open = [self.root]\n        self._skipping = 0\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if self._skipping or tag in _SKIPPED:\n            self._skipping += tag not in _VOID\n            return\n        element = _Element(tag, {name: value or \"\" for name, value in attrs})\n        self._open[-1].children.append(element)\n        if tag not in _VOID:\n            self._open.append(element)\n\n    def handle_startendtag(self, tag, attrs):\n        if not self._skipping and tag not in _SKIPPED:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(_Element(tag, {n: v or \"\" for n, v in attrs}))\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag):\n        if self._skipping:\n            self._skipping -= tag in _SKIPPED or 0\n            return\n        for depth in range(len(self._open) - 1, 0, -1):\n            if self._open[depth].tag == tag:\n                del self._open[depth:]\n                return\n\n    def handle_data(self, data):\n        if not self._skipping:\n            self._open[-1].children.append(data)\n\n\ndef _tree(html: str) -> _Element:\n    builder = _TreeBuilder()\n    builder.feed(html)\n    builder.close()\n    return builder.root\n\n\n# Every ASCII punctuation character that can start Markdown syntax anywhere in\n# a line. A backslash before any ASCII punctuation is always a literal.\n_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\`*_\\[\\]<>&|#~!])\")\n_WHITESPACE = re.compile(r\"[ \\t\\n\\r\\f]+\")\n# At the start of a line, the syntax that _ESCAPED leaves alone: a list\n# marker, a setext underline, or a numbered list's \"1.\" or \"1)\".\n_LINE_START = re.compile(r\"^(?:([-+=])|(\\d+)([.)]))\")\n# In a link's destination: what would end it early, and what Markdown would\n# otherwise read as an escape or an entity.\n_DESTINATION_ENCODED = re.compile(r\"[\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]\")\n_DESTINATION_ESCAPED = re.compile(r\"([\\\\()&])\")\n\n# A line break, in inline Markdown before it is split into lines. Writer text\n# never holds one: _escape turns every newline into a space.\n_BREAK = \"\\n\"\n_BOLD = {\"strong\", \"b\"}\n_ITALIC = {\"em\", \"i\"}\n\n# The title is the page's only H1, so a pasted H1 becomes a Section; the\n# Editor has no level below a Subsection.\n_HEADING_LEVELS = {\"h1\": 2, \"h2\": 2, \"h3\": 3, \"h4\": 3, \"h5\": 3, \"h6\": 3}\n_LISTS = {\"ul\", \"ol\"}\n_TABLE_SECTIONS = {\"thead\", \"tbody\", \"tfoot\"}\n_CELLS = {\"th\", \"td\"}\n# Elements that hold blocks, not inline text. Any other element is inline;\n# one the Editor doesn't write (a <div> or <section> from a paste) is a\n# wrapper, and only what is in it is kept.\n_BLOCK_TAGS = {\"p\", \"blockquote\", \"table\", \"hr\", \"pre\", \"li\", \"tr\", \"caption\",\n               *_LISTS, *_HEADING_LEVELS, *_TABLE_SECTIONS, *_CELLS,\n               \"div\", \"section\", \"article\", \"header\", \"footer\", \"main\", \"aside\", \"nav\",\n               \"figure\", \"figcaption\", \"address\", \"details\", \"summary\", \"dl\", \"dt\", \"dd\",\n               \"center\"}\n# A column is right-aligned when every body cell in it that isn't missing is\n# a number (spec #14, \"Tables\"), and left-aligned otherwise.\n_MISSING = {\"\", \"—\", \"n/a\"}\n_DIGITS = r\"(?:\\d{1,3}(?:,\\d{3})+|\\d+)(?:\\.\\d+)?\"\n_NUMBER = re.compile(rf\"[-+]?\\$?{_DIGITS}%?|\\(\\$?{_DIGITS}%?\\)\")\n\n\ndef is_link(href: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Whether the Editor keeps a link to `href` (spec #14, \"Links\"): an\n    `https:` or `mailto:` address, or a site link.\"\"\"\n    return href.lower().startswith(LINK_SCHEMES) or REFERENCE.fullmatch(href) is not None\n\n\ndef _escape(text: str) -> str:\n    return _ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", _WHITESPACE.sub(\" \", text))\n\n\ndef _escape_line_start(line: str) -> str:\n    return _LINE_START.sub(lambda m: f\"\\\\{m[1]}\" if m[1] else f\"{m[2]}\\\\{m[3]}\", line)\n\n\ndef _destination(url: str) -> str:\n    url = _DESTINATION_ENCODED.sub(lambda m: f\"%{ord(m[0]):02X}\", url)\n    return _DESTINATION_ESCAPED.sub(r\"\\\\\\1\", url)\n\n\ndef _is_block(node: _Element | str) -> bool:\n    return isinstance(node, _Element) and (node.tag in _BLOCK_TAGS or _LOCKED in node.attrs)\n\n\ndef _locked_token(node: _Element) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token of a locked block as the Editor posts it: empty, since what\n    it shows is only for display and what is saved comes from the stored\n    body. {"parentUuid":"52b156cf-1670-4078-b345-e8ea6f64d23b","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"3fed6bb3-3edb-447d-888d-7ec4eb8a7614","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0125uXBTzc3exBWg4Huz1dsR","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"T16: Chart rendering (issue #19). A body with an invalid Chart is refused\nwith a named error on every save path, the Editor's and the Markdown\nfallback's, and a Chart saved from an edited body is in canonical form.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\nfrom html import unescape\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import data_bites, db, reports\nfrom tests.conftest import csrf_from, post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT, create_report\nfrom tests.test_t13_editor_routes import edit_page, field, save, textarea\nfrom tests.test_t16_charts import CANONICAL, VIOLATIONS, fence, source\n\nKINDS = [pytest.param(\"data-bites\", BITE, create_bite, data_bites, id=\"data-bite\"),\n         pytest.param(\"reports\", REPORT, create_report, reports, id=\"report\")]\n\n\ndef error_of(response) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The refused form's page, as text a writer reads.\"\"\"\n    assert response.status_code == 400, response.status_code\n    return unescape(response.text)\n\n\ndef store_body(module, item_id: str, body: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Write a body as it may have been stored under older rules, past\n    every save path's checks.\"\"\"\n    table = {data_bites: \"data_bites\", reports: \"reports\"}[module]\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET body = ? WHERE id = ?\", (body, item_id))\n\n\ndef stored_body(module, item_id: str) -> str:\n    return module.get(int(item_id))[\"body\"]\n\n\ndef fallback_save(c: TestClient, kind: str, item_id: str, page: str, body: str):\n    \"\"\"POST the edit form as it is without the Editor's script: the\n    textarea's Markdown, and no Editor HTML.\"\"\"\n    return c.post(f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\", follow_redirects=False, data={\n        \"title\": re.search(r'name=\"title\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)[1],\n        \"slug\": re.search(r'name=\"slug\" value=\"([^\"]*)\"', page)[1],\n        \"body\": body, \"item_base\": field(page, \"item_base\"), \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(page)})\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef analyst(client_as):\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\n# Refused on every save path.\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"text, message\", VIOLATIONS)\ndef test_the_markdown_fallback_refuses_each_invalid_chart_by_name(analyst, text, message):\n    body = \"Intro.\\n\\n\" + fence(source()) + \"\\n\" + fence(text)\n    page = error_of(post_form(analyst, \"/admin/data-bites\", {**BITE, \"body\": body}))\n    assert \"Chart 2: \" in page and message in page\n    assert BITE[\"slug\"] not in analyst.get(\"/admin/data-bites\").text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"text, message\", VIOLATIONS)\ndef test_the_editor_refuses_a_stored_invalid_chart_by_name(analyst, text, message):\n    \"\"\"A Chart stored under older rules reaches the Editor's save path as a\n    locked block. Saving the item, untouched or not, names it.\"\"\"\n    item_id = create_bite(analyst)\n    body = \"Intro.\\n\\n\" + fence(text)\n    store_body(data_bites, item_id, body)\n    page = edit_page(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id)\n    assert \"Chart 1: \" in error_of(save(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id, page))\n    edited = error_of(save(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id, page, body_dirty=\"1\",\n                           body_html=\"<p>Intro, edited.</p>\" + _locked(page)))\n    assert \"Chart 1: \" in edited and message in edited\n    assert stored_body(data_bites, item_id) == body\n\n\n\"\"\"Shared test fixtures.\n\n`client` gives you the app. `client_as(role)` gives you a client that is logged\nin as a seeded user of that role — it works as soon as your login route exists,\nso access-control tests stay one line:\n\n    def test_editor_cannot_manage_users(client_as):\n        assert client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/users\").status_code in (302, 403)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import db, settings, users\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\"},\n    \"editor\": {\"email\": \"editor@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-editor-pw\"},\n}\n\n\ndef csrf_from(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', html)\n    assert match, \"no csrf_token field in the page\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef post_form(c: TestClient, path: str, data: dict, *, with_csrf=True):\n    \"\"\"POST an admin form as the logged-in client, with the session's CSRF token.\"\"\"\n    if with_csrf:\n        data = {**data, \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)}\n    return c.post(path, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef user_row(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"This user's row of the Director's user list, as HTML.\"\"\"\n    for row in director.get(\"/admin/users\").text.split(\"<tr\")[1:]:\n        if email in row:\n            return row\n    raise AssertionError(f\"{email} is not listed\")\n\n\ndef user_id(director: TestClient, email: str) -> str:\n    return re.match(r' id=\"user-(\\d+)\"', user_row(director, email)).group(1)\n\n\ndef second_analyst(director: TestClient) -> TestClient:\n    \"\"\"A logged-in client for a second, named Analyst (not the seeded one).\"\"\"\n    account = {\"name\": \"Riley Intern\", \"email\": \"riley@example.test\",\n               \"password\": \"a-long-enough-password\", \"role\": \"editor\"}\n    assert post_form(director, \"/admin/users\", account).status_code == 303\n    c = TestClient(create_app())\n    token = csrf_from(c.get(\"/login\").text)\n69:def test_a_drafts_site_preview_is_its_public_page_with_the_unsaved_edits(\n87:def test_a_data_bites_preview_has_its_date_line(client_as):\n96:def Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**\\n\\nStart a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:\\n\\nToolSearch with query \\\"select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp\\\"\\n\\nAdd task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.\",\"## claude.ai Claude Docs\\nClaude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = [\\\"topic.index\\\"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {\\\"kind\\\":\\\"project\\\",\\\"create\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"<title>\\\",\\\"doc\\\":{\\\"blocks\\\":{\\\"asof\\\":{\\\"type\\\":\\\"date\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"<today>\\\"},\\\"me\\\":{\\\"type\\\":\\\"mention\\\",\\\"user\\\":\\\"me\\\"},\\\"s1\\\":{\\\"type\\\":\\\"pending\\\",\\\"intent\\\":\\\"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to\\\"},\\\"s2\\\":{…}},\\\"markdown\\\":\\\"# <title>\\\\n\\\\n<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>\\\\n\\\\n<?claude block s1?>\\\\n\\\\n<?claude block s2?>\\\"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = [\\\"topic.index\\\"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: \\\"<root id>\\\"`.\"],\"removedNames\":[]},\"type\":\"attachment\",\"uuid\":\"b966aa4c-1533-4dd0-94ca-05d447f5aefc\",\"timestamp\":\"2026-10-01T00:08:56.015Z\",\"rendered\":[{\"content\":\"<system-reminder>\\n# MCP Server Instructions\\n\\nThe following MCP servers have provided instructions for how to use their tools and resources:\\n\\n## claude-in-chrome\\n**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**\\n\\nStart a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:\\n\\nToolSearch with query \\\"select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp\\\"\\n\\nAdd task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.\\n\\n## claude.ai Claude Docs\\nClaude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai …/artifact/… link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = [\\\"topic.index\\\"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Summoned by a doc comment (turn headed `[Artifact comment sent to Claude]`, `;thread=<root id>`): answer ONLY with a doc comment under that root (`create` an utterance, parent `<root id>`) — no artifact/platform comment tool: that relay thread is resolved and never reaches the doc; an edit asked there → `update` with `answering: \\\"<root id>\\\"`.\\n</system-reminder>\"}],\"renderedRole\":\"system\",\"userType\":\"external\",\"entrypoint\":\"cli\",\"cwd\":\"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms\",\"sessionId\":\"6d83085c-4859-4681-9c06-b59afa52f437\",\"version\":\"2.1.285\",\"gitBranch\":\"main\"}\n14:{\"parentUuid\":\"b966aa4c-1533-4dd0-94ca-05d447f5aefc\",\"isSidechain\":false,\"attachment\":{\"type\":\"skill_listing\",\"content\":\"- browse: Fast headless browser for QA testing and site dogfooding. Navigate any URL, interact with\\nelements, verify page state, diff before/after actions, take annotated screenshots, check\\nresponsive layouts, test forms and uploads, handle dialogs, and assert element states.\\n~100ms per command. Use when you need to test a feature, verify a deployment, dogfood a\\nuser flow, or file a bug with evidence. Use when asked to \\\"open in browser\\\", \\\"test the\\nsite\\\", \\\"take a screenshot\\\", or \\\"dogfood this\\\". (gstack)\\n- gstack: Fast headless browser for QA testing and site dogfooding. Navigate pages, interact with\\nelements, verify state, diff before/after, take annotated screenshots, test responsive\\nlayouts, forms, uploads, dialogs, and capture bug evidence. Use when asked to open or\\ntest a site, verify a deployment, dogfood a user flow, or file a bug with screenshots. (gstack)\\n- humanizer: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text. Detects and fixes patterns including:\\ninflated symbolism, promotional language, superficial -ing analyses, vague\\nattributions, em dash overuse, rule of three, AI vocabulary words, passive\\nvoice, negative parallelisms, and filler phrases.\\n- PM-Case-Prep: Use when the user wants to practice PM product case interviews, work through a product design challenge, or get coached on PM frameworks (RICE, AARRR, CUPS-PDM, CIRCLES). {"parentUuid":"7d832bfe-f727-4a6d-b4b7-46a9049b74e7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfbhvi8R3NtCwd2krimC2","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've read the whole stack for T17 (#20). Before I write any code, here's the plan for your approval.\n\n**Plan for T17: Chart builder**\n\n1. **Field-level errors in `app/charts.py`.** `ChartError` gets a `field` that says where the problem is (`title`, `unit`, `categories.3`, `series.1.name`, `series.1.values.3`, …). A new `charts.problems(source)` returns *every* field error at once, using T16's existing checks: each string, each category, each series name, and each cell's number rules. If no single field is wrong, it returns the first whole-chart error instead (counts, duplicates, unit conflict). The messages stay T16's.\n2. **Preview endpoint `POST /admin/charts/preview`.** It requires login and CSRF, saves nothing, and returns JSON: the errors, the figure drawn by `chart_drawing.draw`, the canonical block, and a suggestion. Its tests go first (TDD): login, CSRF, nothing saved, field-level errors.\n3. **Charts in the Editor (server).** A valid top-level `chart` fence stops being a locked block. The Editor shows it as a card, `<div class=\"admin-editor-chart\" data-chart=\"…\">` with the drawn figure inside. On save, `markdown_form` turns the card back into the canonical fence. A card moved into a list, quote, or paragraph is refused, the same way a moved locked block is. Tests cover the round trip, untouched-is-byte-for-byte, and a forged `data-chart`.\n4. **The dialog (`static/editor.js`).** An \"Insert chart\" toolbar button opens it. It has:\n   - Type, Title, axis labels, Units, Source/note\n   - the grid, with add/remove for 1–4 series and categories up to the type's limit\n   - the live chart, redrawn on a 250 ms debounce\n   - each error under its cell or field\n   - Insert, disabled until the chart is valid\n\n   The card in the body gets Edit and Remove.\n5. **Paste into the grid.** Tab-separated text fills the grid from the selected cell. A non-numeric first row goes to the series names and a non-numeric first column goes to the category names.\n6. **CSS** for the card and dialog (`admin-chart-builder-*`), including a check at 390px.\n7. **Browser check** in Chrome (typing, Excel paste, one error of each kind, a 4-series line chart, Edit/Remove, 390px). Then `/code-review`, the findings comment on #20, and the commit `T17: … Closes #20`. I'll commit after steps 1–3 and again after 4–6.\n\n**Choices I'd like you to confirm:**\n\n- **a. Where errors show.** To avoid red marks everywhere on a blank dialog, an error only shows next to a field once that field has been typed in, left, or pasted into. Insert stays disabled the whole time any error exists, shown or not.\n- **b. The horizontal bar suggestion.** It shows on a *vertical bar* chart when any category is longer than 15 characters, as a hint with a \"Use horizontal bar\" button. It never switches the type itself.\n- **c. Side effect on the fallback.** Valid Charts stop being locked blocks, so if the Editor's script fails, the Markdown textarea will show the chart's JSON instead of `locked-0`. The fallback save path still validates it. Invalid stored charts stay locked.\n- **d. New series name.** A new chart starts with one series named \"Series 1\", because the grammar needs a name even though a single-series chart shows no legend.\n\nShould I go ahead, and do a–d work for you?"}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":760,"cache_read_input_tokens":144016,"output_tokens":1476,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":281},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":760,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1476,"cache_read_input_tokens":144016,"cache_creation_input_tokens":760,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":760},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"serverClassifierRequest":"3ae408db-b525-46cf-8c52-efe07830f860","apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011Cfbhvhgsfgdudjmfr31AT","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:implement","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"6d123afe-3b53-4434-af67-03633c443165","timestamp":"2026-10-01T14:52:34.133Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"926c42f6-77b8-4443-a7eb-ec96fce93b5c","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

The user pastes by hand; Claude reads the saved draft back.\n- **Scratch instance**: run `cms serve --port 8001` with `CMS_DATABASE`/`CMS_UPLOADS` in the session scratchpad and `scripts/seed_demo.py` ((\"5\", \"5%\"), {\"unit\": {\"text\": \"$\", \"position\": \"prefix\"}},\n     \"'Senior': '5%' is in %, but the chart's units are $\"),\n    ((\"5 Students\", \"6\"), {\"unit\": {\"text\":   \"<10\"\n      ]\n    }\n  ]\n}\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef test_the_canonical_form_orders_keys_as_the_grammar_and_ends_with_a_newline():\n    shuffled = {\"series\": [{\"values\": [\"91%\", \"<10\"], ({\"series\": [series(\"1\", \"2\", name=\"A\"), series(\"3\", \"4\", name=\"A\")]}, \"series.1.name\",\n     \"the series name 'A' appears twice\"),\n    ({\"series\": [series(\"1\", \"2\", [series(\"5$%\", \"1\")]}, \"series.0.values.0\", \"isn't a number\"),\n    ({\"series\": [series(\"1\", \"x\" * 21)]}, \"series.0.values.1\", \"must be at most 20\"),\n    ({\"series\": ({\"series\": [series(\"1\", \"2\", name=\"A\"), series(\"3\", \"4\", name=\"A\")]}, \"series.1.name\",\n     \"the series name 'A' appears twice\"),\n    ({\"series\": [series(\"1\", \"2\", __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import chart_drawing, charts, data_bites, reports\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\nfrom tests.conftest    if with_csrf:\n        data[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_from(c.get(\"/admin\").text)\n    return c.post(PATH, data=data, follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef answer(c, text: str) -> dict:\n    response = (response.status_code, response.headers[\"location\"]) == (303, \"/login\")\n\n\ndef test_it_requires_a_csrf_token(analyst):\n    assert preview(analyst, source(), with_csrf=False).status_code == test_a_valid_chart_is_drawn_as_the_public_page_draws_it(client_as, role):\n    text = source(type=\"line\", categories=[\"2023\", \"2024\", \"2025\"],\n                  series=[series(\"91%\", \"<10\", \"\", name=f\"S{i}\") for i in range(4)])\n    found = answer(client_as(role), text)\n    assert found[\"errors\"] == []\n    assert found[\"chart\"] == charts.parse(text).canonical()\n    public = str(render_markdown(fence(found[\"chart\"])))\n\n    def without_ids(html: str) -> str:\n        return re.sub(r\"chart-[0-9a-f]{32}-[0-9]+-title\", \"ID\", html)\n\n    assert without_ids(found[\"figure\"]) == without_ids(public)\n    assert chart_drawing.TITLE_ID.search(found[\"figure\"])\n\n\ndef test_each_error_comes_back_with_its_field(analyst):\n    found = answer(analyst, source(title=\"\", series=[series(\"482\", \"abc\", name=\"Fall\")]))\n    assert found[\"figure\"] is None and found[\"chart\"] is None\n    assert found[\"errors\"] == [\n        {\"field\": \"title\", \"message\": \"The title must be 1 to 120 characters\"},\n        {\"field\": \"series.0.values.1\",\n         \"message\": \"Series 'Fall', 'Senior': 'abc' isn't a number\"}]\n\n\ndef test_a_whole_chart_error_comes_back_with_its_field(analyst):\n    found = answer(analyst, source(series=[series(\"$1\", \"2%\")]))\n    assert found[\"errors\"] == [{\"field\": \"series.0.values.1\", \"message\":\n                                \"Series 'Fall 2025', 'Senior': '2%' is in %, but the \"\n                                \"chart's units are $\"}]\n\n\ndef test_an_error_in_no_one_field_has_none(analyst):\n    found = answer(analyst, \"{\")\n    assert [error[\"field\"] for error in found[\"errors\"]] == [None]\n    assert found[\"errors\"][0][\"message\"].startswith(\"Its data can't be read\")\n\n\ndef test_a_long_category_suggests_a_horizontal_bar_chart_even_with_errors(analyst):\n    text = source(title=\"\", categories=[\"First-year\", \"Students living off campus\"])\n    assert answer(analyst, text)[\"suggestion\"] == \"hbar\"\n    assert answer(analyst, source())[\"suggestion\"] is None\n\n\ndef test_writer_text_is_only_escaped_text_in_the_figure(analyst):\n    hostile = '\"><svg onload=alert(1)></title>&'\n    found = answer(analyst, source(title=hostile, source=\"<script>x</script>\"))\n    assert \"<script>\" not in found[\"figure\"] and \"onload=\" not in found[\"figure\"].replace(\n        \"&quot;&gt;&lt;svg onload=\", \"\")\n    assert \"&quot;&gt;&lt;svg onload=alert(1)&gt;&lt;/title&gt;&amp;\" in found[\"figure\"]\n\n\ndef test_it_saves_nothing(analyst, tmp_path):\n    before = ([dict(row) for row in data_bites.list_all()],\n              [dict(row) reports.list_all()])\n    assert before == after\n\n\ndef test_a_missing_chart_field_is_an_error_not_a_crash(analyst):\n    token = csrf_from(analyst.get(\"/admin\").text)\n    response = \"\"\"Each card's Chart, as its data-chart holds it.\"\"\"\n    return [unescape(value) for value in CARD.findall(html)]\n\n\ndef card(text: str, content: str = \"\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"A card as the Editor posts it back.\"\"\"\n    return f'<div class=\"admin-editor-chart\" data-chart=\"{escape(text)}\">{content}</div>'\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef analyst(client_as):\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\n# What the Editor shows.\n\ndef test_a_valid_chart_is_a_card_with_its_drawing_and_its_canonical_block():\n    body = \"Intro.\\n\\n\" + fence(source()) + \"\\nOutro.\\n\"\n    assert tokenize(body).locked == ()\n    html = str(editor_html(tokenize(body).markdown, body, None))\n    assert cards(html) == [charts.parse(source()).canonical()]\n    assert 'class=\"chart-figure\"' in html and \"Fall enrollment by class\" in html\n    assert \"data-locked\" not in html and \"```\" not in html\n    assert html.index(\"Intro.\") < html.index(\"admin-editor-chart\") < html.index(\"Outro.\")\n\n\ndef test_each_of_several_charts_is_its_own_card_in_order():\n    first, second = source(title=\"First\"), source(title=\"Second\", type=\"hbar\")\n    body = fence(first) + \"\\nBetween.\\n\\n\" + fence(second)\n    html = str(editor_html(body, body, None))\n    assert [json.loads(chart)[\"title\"] for chart in cards(html)] == [\"First\", \"Second\"]\n    assert len(set(re.findall(r'id=\"(chart-[0-9a-f]{32}-\\d+-title)\"', html))) == 2\n\n\ndef test_a_chart_straight_after_a_paragraph_is_still_its_own_card():\n    body = \"Intro.\\n\" + fence(source())\n    html = str(editor_html(body, body, None))\n    assert len(cards(html)) == 1 and \"<p>Intro.</p>\" in html\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"body\", [\n    fence(source(title=\"\")),\n    fence(\"{\"),\n    \"> \" + fence(source()).replace(\"\\n\", \"\\n> \").rstrip(\"> \"),\n    \"- item\\n\\n  \" + fence(source()).replace(\"\\n\", \"\\n  \").rstrip(\" \"),\n])\ndef test_an_invalid_or_nested_chart_is_a_locked_block(body):\n    assert len(tokenize(body).locked) == 1\n    html = str(editor_html(tokenize(body).markdown, body, None))\n    assert cards(html) == [] and \"data-locked\" in html\n\n\ndef test_writer_text_in_a_card_is_escaped():\n    hostile = '\"><script>alert(1)</script>'\n    body = fence(source(title=hostile))\n    html = str(editor_html(body, body, None))\n    assert \"<script>\" not in html\n    assert json.loads(cards(html)[0])[\"title\"] == hostile\n\n\n# What a card saves.\n\ndef test_a_card_is_saved_as_the_canonical_block():\n    shuffled = json.dumps(dict(reversed(list(json.loads(CANONICAL).items()))))\n    html = \"<p>Intro.</p>\" + card(shuffled, \"<figure>drawn</figure>\") + \"<p>Outro.</p>\"\n    assert to_markdown(html) == f\"Intro.\\n\\n```chart\\n{CANONICAL}```\\n\\nOutro.\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_what_a_card_shows_is_never_saved():\n    html = f\"<table><tr><td>{card(source())}</td></tr></table>\",\n])\ndef test_a_card_moved_into_another_block_is_refused(html):\n    with pytest.raises(ContentError, match=\"A Chart was moved into\"):\n        to_markdown(html)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"text, message\", [\n    (\"{\", \"Chart 2: its data can't be read\"),\n    (source(title=\"\"), \"Chart 2: the title must be\"),\n    ('{\"title\": \"```\\\\n# Injected\"}', \"Chart 2: \"),\n])\ndef test_a_card_whose_chart_is_invalid_is_refused_by_its_place(text, message):\n    html = card(source()) + \"<p>Between.</p>\" + card(text)\n    with pytest.raises(ContentError, match=re.escape(message)):\n        to_markdown(html)\n\n\n# Through the edit form.\n\ndef test_a_round_trip_through_the_editor_saves_the_canonical_block(analyst):\n    body = \"Intro.\\n\\n\" + fence(CANONICAL.removesuffix(\"\\n\"))\n    item_id = create_bite(analyst, body=body)\n    page = edit_page(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id)\n    edited = editor_content(page).replace(\"Intro.\", \"Intro, edited.\")\n    assert save(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id, page, body_dirty=\"1\",\n                body_html=edited).status_code == 303\n    assert stored_body(data_bites, item_id) == body.replace(\"Intro.\", \"Intro, edited.\")\n\n\ndef test_an_untouched_body_with_a_card_keeps_its_bytes(analyst):\n    body = \"Intro.\\n\\n~~~chart\\n\" + source() + \"\\n~~~\\n\"\n    item_id = create_bite(analyst)\n    store_body(data_bites, item_id, body)\n    page = edit_page(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id)\n    assert save(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id, page).status_code == 303\n    assert stored_body(data_bites, item_id) == body\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", [\"editor\", \"fallback\"])\ndef test_an_edit_around_a_stored_chart_saves_it_in_canonical_form(analyst, path):\n    item_id = create_bite(analyst)\n    store_body(data_bites, item_id, \"Intro.\\n\\n~~~chart\\n\" + source() + \"\\n~~~\\n\")\n    page = edit_page(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id)\n    if path == \"editor\":\n        response = save(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id, page, body_dirty=\"1\",\n                        body_html=editor_content(page).replace(\"Intro.\", \"Intro, edited.\"))\n    else:\n        assert source() in textarea(page)\n        response = fallback_save(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id, = edit_page(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id)\n    chart = charts.parse(source(series=[series(\"1\", \"<10\")])).canonical()\n    response = save(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id, page, body_dirty=\"1\",\n                    body_html=f\"<p>Intro.</p>{card(chart)}<p></p>\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert stored_body(data_bites, item_id) == edit_page(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id)\n    edited = re.sub(r'<div class=\"admin-editor-chart\".*', \"\", editor_content(page), flags=re.S)\n    assert save(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id, page, body_dirty=\"1\",\n                body_html=edited).status_code == 303\n    assert stored_body(data_bites, item_id) == \"Intro.\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_an_invalid_card_refuses_the_save_and_names_the_chart(analyst):\n    item_id = create_bite(analyst, body=\"Intro.\\n\")\n    page = edit_page(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id)\n    response = save(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id, page, body_dirty=\"1\",\n                    body_html=\"<p>Intro.</p>\" + card(source(series=[series(\"1\", \"abc\")])))\n    assert response.status_code == response.text)\n    assert stored_body(data_bites, item_id) == \"Intro.\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_the_site_preview_draws_a_card(analyst):\n    from tests.conftest import csrf_from\n    item_id = create_bite(analyst, body=\"Intro.\\n\")\n    page = edit_page(analyst, \"data-bites\", item_id)\n    response = analyst.post(f\"/admin/data-bites/{item_id}/preview\", data={\n        \"title\": \"T\", \"body\": \"\", \"body_dirty\": \"1\", \"csrf_token\": csrf_from(page),\n        \"body_html\": \"<p>Intro.</p>\" + card(source())})\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert {"parentUuid":"bb908e74-e311-4ab2-90b1-c1c030805120","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfbiys5s7pXzpTWnghTJQ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Steps 1–3 are done, tested, and committed as `2d88dfe`. Following your checkpoint rule, I'm stopping here before the browser-side work.\n\n**What's in place (server side):**\n\n- **Every error now says which field it's in.** Each chart error is tagged with its field or cell (`title`, `categories.1`, `series.0.values.1`, …). The new `charts.problems()` reports every field's error at once. Errors about the whole chart (too many categories, a duplicate name, mixed units) only appear once each field is right on its own. The wording is still T16's.\n- **The live-drawing route `POST /admin/charts/preview` works.** It requires login (otherwise a 303 to `/login`) and CSRF (otherwise 403), and saves nothing. It returns the errors by field, the chart drawn exactly as the public page draws it, the canonical block, and the `hbar` suggestion. The suggestion comes back even while the chart still has errors.\n- **A valid Chart is now an editable card in the Editor.** Previously it was a locked block. On save, the card becomes the canonical `chart` block. A card moved into a list, quote, table, or paragraph is refused, and so is a card holding an invalid chart; that error names the chart by its position (\"Chart 2: …\"). An invalid or nested chart is still a locked block.\n- **Tests:** 63 new tests for T17. I changed three T16 tests that assumed \"a valid chart is a locked block\"; T16's own comments called that an interim state. The full suite was 1,210 passed with only those three expected failures, and all three pass after the update.\n\n**One behaviour change from T16:** a stored chart that isn't in canonical form (`~~~` fence, keys out of order) keeps its exact bytes only when the body is saved untouched. If you edit anything else in the body, that chart is rewritten in canonical form, matching the spec's \"any body the Editor has changed is rewritten in one standard form\". I'll mention this in the closing comment on #20.\n\n**Next (steps 4–6):** the \"Insert chart\" dialog and the card's Edit and Remove buttons in `static/editor.js`, paste into the grid, and the CSS. After that comes the Chrome check, where I'll need you to do the real Excel paste by hand. As the writer types, the\n  // server checks the Chart and draws it (app.routes.charts), with the\n  // drawing the public page has; each of its errors shows by its field or\n  // cell, and Insert waits until there are none. The dialog is outside the\n  // form, so nothing in it is posted with the item.\n\n  const CHART_TYPES = [[\"bar\", \"Vertical bar\"], [\"hbar\", \"Horizontal bar\"], [\"line\", \"Line\"]];\n  // The grammar's limits (app.charts), for the grid's buttons and pastes.\n  const MOST_CATEGORIES = {bar: 30, hbar: 30, line: 60};\n  const MOST_SERIES = 4;\n  const PASTE_CUT = \"The paste was larger than a chart can be, so its last rows or columns were left out.\";\n  const NOT_DRAWN = \"The chart can't be drawn right now. The server decides what is valid.\n  const MISSING_VALUES = new Set([\"\", \"—\", \"n/a\"]);\n  const SUPPRESSED = /^(\\*|(<|≤|<=)\\d+)$/;\n  const NUMBER = /^[-+]?\\(?\\$?(\\d{1,3}(,\\d{3})+|\\d+)(\\.\\d+)?%?\\)?( \\p{L}+([ -]\\p{L}+)*)?$/u;\n  let builders = 0;\n\n  function isValue(text) {\n    const typed = text.trim();\n    return MISSING_VALUES.has(typed.toLowerCase()) || SUPPRESSED.test(typed) || NUMBER.test(typed);\n  }\n\n  function chartBuilder(previewPath, csrfToken) {\n    const id = `admin-chart-builder-${++builders}`;\n    const field = (name, label, extra = \"\") => `\n      <p><label>${label} <input type=\"text\" data-field=\"${name}\" autocomplete=\"off\"\n        aria-describedby=\"${id}-${name}-error${extra ? aria-describedby=\"${id}-grid-hint\"></table>\n      </div>\n      <p class=\"admin-chart-builder-grid-tools\">\n        <button type=\"button\" data-builder=\"add-category\">Add category</button>\n
